# Debian packages the setup-node-ffmpeg action installs.
#
# The apt cache key hashes this file, so editing it is what invalidates the
# cache. Each [scope] header starts a group: the ffmpeg group is installed when
# the action's ffmpeg input is true, and the playwright group when its
# playwright input is true. Every group is downloaded on a cache miss, so the
# cached debs are the same no matter which job fills the cache first.

[ffmpeg]
ffmpeg

# The Chromium system libraries behind `npx playwright install-deps chromium`
# on ubuntu-24.04-x64, copied from Playwright 1.62.0 nativeDeps so the e2e job
# can take them from the deb cache instead of running apt during install-deps.
# Refresh this list when the Playwright version moves.
[playwright]
libasound2t64
libatk-bridge2.0-0t64
libatk1.0-0t64

libcairo2
libcups2t64

libgbm1
libglib2.0-0t64
libnspr4
libnss3
libpango-1.0-0
